残观风歇，煞气渐敛。

渡边苍玄伏尸石坛，五方镇魂咒阵烟消云散，四象锁煞阵彻底崩毁，近百式神化作漫天黑烟消散无形。整座荒废古观被硝烟与雷气笼罩，断壁残垣间再无半分邪祟气息，只剩残破的青砖荒草，默默承载一场正邪厮杀后的狼藉。

众人缓步走入古观庭院，气息稍稍平复。

连日从西风村一路破关斩将，破阴阵、平蛊瘴、剿甲贺忍、荡式神兵、斩大咒师，一路横推东瀛三派所有外围防线，身心皆有疲累，却无一人懈怠。

林佳走到石坛旁，蹲伏检查渡边苍玄尸身，又扫视古观地基纹路：“这座古观改造成中转祭台，不仅是关卡隘口，更是山巅祭坛的地气分流点。邪派借古观地脉接引阴气，源源不断补给主峰献祭大阵，如今阵毁人亡，等于直接切断了外围地气补给。”

杨瑞绕着古观残垣走了一圈，指尖抚过斑驳的墙纹：“地基深处还留有地底暗道入口，和西风村祠堂的密道相连，是东瀛人手、蛊虫、物资转运的隐秘脉络。如今大阵已破，暗道失去价值，留着也是隐患，不如直接封死崩塌。”

胡九郎颔首：“封死暗道，抹去邪阵残留纹路，免得日后再有邪人借此盘踞，重兴煞局。”

李安琪随即抬手引动山石灵气，古观后山崖壁土石松动，轰然塌陷，硬生生将地底密道入口彻底掩埋封死；再以灵气抚平地面残存咒纹，以道门灵光净化残留阴煞，不留半点后患。

钱丹放出清心蛊，绕着古观周身盘旋一周，净化空气中残留的蛊毒与咒气，避免邪煞余韵浸染山林地气。

王欣欣、茉沫清理战场，把散落的忍者兵器、式神残骸、咒器碎片收拢焚毁，不留下任何可以被邪人利用的物件。

李二牛押着织田美子站在古观山门处，望着云雾缠绕的主峰之巅，感慨道：“外围关卡尽数扫清，再往上走，就是直通云巅的山路，再无任何缓冲屏障，直面龙脉祭坛了。”

织田美子面色惨白，眼底满是绝望。

Chapter 91: The passage at the top of the clouds, the vision of dragon veins - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

Can watch the wind subside, the evil spirit gradually subsides.

Watanabe Cangxuan laid his body on the stone altar, the five directions soul-suppressing spell array disappeared into smoke, the four-image locking evil array completely collapsed, and nearly a hundred shikigami turned into black smoke and disappeared invisible.The entire abandoned ancient temple was shrouded in gunpowder smoke and thunder, and there was no evil atmosphere among the ruins. Only the broken green bricks and grass were left, silently carrying the mess after a battle between good and evil.

Everyone slowly walked into the ancient temple courtyard, their breaths calming down a little.

In the past few days, they had broken through barriers and killed generals all the way from Xifeng Village, destroyed the Yin Formation, quelled Gu Miasma, annihilated Jiahe Ren, Dang Shishen Weapon, and killed the Great Curse Master. They had pushed all the outer defense lines of the three Japanese sects all the way. They were both physically and mentally exhausted, but no one was slacking off.

Lin Jia walked to the stone altar, crouched down to inspect Watanabe Cangxuan's corpse, and scanned the foundation lines of the ancient temple: "This ancient temple has been transformed into a transit altar. It is not only a pass, but also a diversion point for earth energy for the altar on the top of the mountain. The evil sect uses the earth veins of the ancient temple to attract yin energy and continuously supplies the main peak sacrifice array. Now that the array is destroyed and people are killed, it is equivalent to directly cutting off the supply of earth energy to the periphery."

Yang Rui walked around the ruins of the ancient temple and stroked the mottled wall patterns with his fingertips: "There is still an entrance to the underground secret passage deep in the foundation, which is connected to the secret passage of the Xifeng Village ancestral hall. It is a secret connection for the transfer of Japanese hands, Gu insects, and materials. Now that the formation has been broken, the secret passage has lost its value, and leaving it is a hidden danger. It is better to seal it and collapse directly."

Hu Jiulang nodded: "Seal the secret passage and erase the remaining traces of the evil formation, so that no evil person will take advantage of it to take hold in the future and revive the situation."

Li Anqi then raised his hand to activate the spiritual energy of the rocks. The earth and rocks on the cliff behind the ancient temple loosened and suddenly collapsed, completely burying and sealing the entrance to the underground secret passage. He then used spiritual energy to smooth out the remaining curse patterns on the ground, and used the Taoist spiritual light to purify the remaining evil spirits, leaving no future trouble.

Qian Dan released the Qingxin Gu, which circled around the ancient temple to purify the remaining poisonous poison and curse energy in the air, and prevent the lingering evil spirit from infecting the atmosphere of the mountains and forests.

Wang Xinxin and Momo cleaned up the battlefield, collecting and burning the scattered ninja weapons, shikigami remains, and cursed weapon fragments, leaving nothing behind that could be used by evil people.

Li Erniu escorted Oda Miko and stood at the gate of the ancient temple, looking at the top of the main peak shrouded in clouds and mist, and said with emotion: "All the peripheral checkpoints have been cleared, and if we go up, we will reach the mountain road leading to the top of the clouds. There is no longer any buffer barrier, and we will face the Dragon Vein Altar directly."

Oda Miko's face was pale, and her eyes were full of despair.
